properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual variant: linear (horizontal bar) or circular (ring).

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Indeterminate mode — looping animation when progress is unknown.

properties.name: wave
properties.description: Enable the wavy (M3 Expressive) active indicator.

properties.name: waveAmplitude
properties.description:
Wave amplitude (center-to-peak) in dp. `0` = auto per M3 spec
(linear 3px, circular 1.6px).

properties.name: waveLength
properties.description:
Wavelength (peak-to-peak) in dp. `0` = auto
(linear 40px for both determinate + indeterminate, circular 15px).

properties.name: waveSpeed
properties.description:
Wave travel speed in dp/second. `0` = auto (= wavelength, i.e. one
wavelength per second per the M3 default).

properties.name: size
properties.description:
Circular indicator outer size in dp. `0` = auto (non-wavy 40px,
wavy 48px per the M3 expressive spec). Clamped to the M3 range 24–240px.

properties.name: complete
properties.description:
Set to `true` to trigger the completion ("closing TV") animation. After it
plays, the indicator self-hides (`visibility:hidden`) and emits `mdComplete` —
EXCEPT the flat (non-wavy) circular variant, which instead rests showing its
empty track ring (the active indicator erases away and the track fades in).
No-op on indeterminate indicators.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

cssParts.name: stop-indicator
cssParts.description: Stop dot at track end (linear determinate)

cssProperties.name: --md-progress-indicator-stop-indicator-trailing-space
cssProperties.description: Space past the stop dot to the trailing edge (default 0)

cssProperties.name: --md-progress-indicator-track-active-indicator-space
cssProperties.description: Gap between track and active indicator (default 4px)

attributes.name: class
attributes.value:
{
          'md-progress-indicator': true,
          [`md-progress-indicator--${this.variant}`]: true,
          'md-progress-indicator--indeterminate': this.indeterminate,
          'md-progress-indicator--wave': this.wave,
          'md-progress-indicator--four-color': this.fourColor,
          'md-progress-indicator--completing': this._completing,
          'md-progress-indicator--complete': this._completed,
        }

name: Progress Indicator
description: How far along an activity is. Linear or circular, determinate or indeterminate, with the M3 Expressive wave treatment and four-colour mode.

notes: Uses native determinate/indeterminate progress. Expressive wave/four-color animations not implemented.
